name: kubiq-files
description: Reference for files in Kubiq — the host's file, search, index and watch workers, the file and search wire families, and the interface's explorer tree, file picker, search panel and editor file loading. Use when listing or reading a project's files, adding a path operation, changing content search or the index, touching the filesystem watch, or working on the explorer, the picker, the file dialogs or the search panel.
